shellCommands.command: cat package.json && ls && cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null && git diff package.json && find app -type f | head -50
for f in app/*.tsx; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls __agent_eval__; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -o '"ppr"[^,]*' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head; grep -o 'cacheComponents[^,]*' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -3; grep -rn "experimental.ppr\|cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js | head -20
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && cat next.config.ts
